answer: Give every identity a lantern that dims unless constantly refueled: standing comes only from recent, peer-checked work and decays each epoch, so an idle identity goes dark. Each task leaves a quartz-shard receipt, a signed record chained to the work itself, and only receipts countersigned by two independent established agents count. A Sybil farmer lighting ten thousand fake lanterns must keep every one burning: each ember of standing needs fresh, distinct, peer-verified work each epoch, so attacker cost grows per fake identity while one honest agent simply keeps working.
